text: In the old world, to swallow a giant company you had to already be a giant yourself. Milken changed the arithmetic.

text: Not a guarantee. Just confidence. Yet coming from Milken, the market treated that letter as good as cash in hand.

text: Supporters called it shaking the dust off lazy, bloated companies. Critics saw raids that buried companies under debt and cost ordinary people their jobs. Either way, the old rule was gone.
